title: AI assistant
purpose: Configure a local or explicitly authorised model for workflow guidance and aggregate interpretation—without making core operation model-dependent.
reviewBody: Never enter direct patient identifiers, use generated text as a final susceptibility report, or treat assistant output as clinical advice. Hidden model reasoning and provider metadata are removed before display.
greeting: I can explain workflows, summarise authorised aggregate outputs, and help inspect data quality. I do not replace microbiology review or clinical judgement.

workspace.title: Assistant workspace
workspace.description: Ask about the application or authorised, de-identified aggregate content.
workspace.placeholder: Ask a workflow question or paste an authorised aggregate summary…
workspace.composerHint: ⌘/Ctrl + Enter to send · Basic app functions never depend on the assistant.

help.optional: The assistant is optional. Data entry, validation, panels, analytics, import, export, masters and sync all work without a model.
help.privacyBody: Prefer a local Ollama model. Hosted providers are disabled until explicit opt-in and must not receive patient-identifiable information.
help.scopeBody: Use the assistant for navigation, explanations and draft text from approved aggregates. It cannot authorise laboratory results or clinical decisions.
